new_numerical_stage_decision.why_current_gate_is_not_sufficient: A positive fixed-feature RNA quantity alone would not alter the already mandatory ordinary/high-EMC plus LGFMS sampling consequence. There is no source-justified detectability/assay-performance rule or compatible all-three control/normalization contrast that turns these heterogeneous rows into defensible culture inclusion/ranking. Inventing a new expression cutoff, pooling gene/transcript quantities, or ranking culture against native TPM would create the desired decision after exposure. Complete historical gene capture and legitimate within-assay controls are material pending fields.
new_numerical_stage_decision.not_a_universal_veto: The conclusion is not that RNA-only or unpaired descriptive model comparisons are inherently useless. A fixed feature observation or compatible population comparison could be useful for a stated RNA experiment with actual interpreted units/controls and a decision-sensitive question. Protein validation and same-donor tissue pairing are not universal prerequisites.
new_numerical_stage_decision.current_authorized_action: Integrate this additive source/claim-scope disposition and preserve the numerical candidate without drafting or promotion. No new calculations, targets, cultures, source queries or interpretation-dependent thresholds are requested.

A source-qualified all-three culture rule with historical target capture, compatible normalization and authenticated within-assay controls or validated RNA-assay inclusion criterion could support a separate before-value model-selection question; it would remain distinct from native EMC-LGFMS replication.
An actual primary published equivalent GPNMB EMC-LGFMS comparison/sampling interpretation would defeat standalone novelty; absent keyword hits cannot close that scope.
